items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I used to rehearse with the next door neighbor. His sister played bass, played one of them bass. He played Dixieland music, you know. And the other fella they called Oscar, Oscar Pierce, he played piano.

ctx.x: And you used to go on rehearsals?

I used to rehearse with the next door neighbor. His sister played bass, played one of them bass. He played Dixieland music, you know. And the other fella they called Oscar, Oscar Pierce, he played piano.
It's all new names to me.
